reviews.name: Cleve Batten
reviews.excerpt:
Had a fantastic time with Prakash, took us up to Annapurna base camp at our own pace and shared his knowledge along the way.

Also had many many laughs along the way :)

Very highly recommend base camp adventures!

reviews.name: Eswaran K S
reviews.excerpt: After conducting detailed survey we planned to go from Kathmandu to Mukthinath. We had taken details from Base camp and others. However , I really appreciate the excellent follow up from Base camp that we decided to go with them. We are extremely happy with the way the tour was conducted. We had an excellent driver for us ( Bala ) , good hotels in Pokhara and Jomson. Also Shiv Bhatta was always available for us for any clarifications. We would strongly recommend anybody to go with them for tours. Thanks Base camp for making our tour very successful. We are extremely thankful and you should continue your service in the same manner.
